channel.title: Tidy Math Sheets — Telling Time Activities

item.title: Telling Time Worksheets That Build Up
item.description: Take kids from o'clock times all the way to reading an analog clock to the minute. Five levels each add one new skill, with both read-the-clock and draw-the-hands practice. 15 worksheets, 180 clocks, and a complete answer key. Instant download: print it tonight, use it tomorrow.
